preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m_permission WHERE code = 'CHANGEEXPIRYDATE_LINE_OF_CREDIT'

changeSet.comment: Maker permission for a Line of Credit expiry date change. Maker-checker is enabled on this command only.

changeSet.author: crediblex

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m_permission WHERE code = 'CHANGEEXPIRYDATE_LINE_OF_CREDIT_CHECKER'

changeSet.comment: Checker permission for approving or rejecting a Line of Credit expiry date change.

changeSet.author: crediblex

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM m_permission WHERE code = 'UPDATE_LINE_OF_CREDIT'

changeSet.comment: Give the new maker and checker permissions to roles that can already update a line of credit.
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT rp.role_id, maker.id FROM m_role_permission rp JOIN m_permission existing ON existing.id = rp.permission_id AND existing.code = 'UPDATE_LINE_OF_CREDIT' JOIN m_permission maker ON maker.code = 'CHANGEEXPIRYDATE_LINE_OF_CREDIT' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission already WHERE already.role_id = rp.role_id AND already.permission_id = maker.id );
INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT rp.role_id, checker.id FROM m_role_permission rp JOIN m_permission existing ON existing.id = rp.permission_id AND existing.code = 'UPDATE_LINE_OF_CREDIT' JOIN m_permission checker ON checker.code = 'CHANGEEXPIRYDATE_LINE_OF_CREDIT_CHECKER' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission already WHERE already.role_id = rp.role_id AND already.permission_id = checker.id );

changeSet.author: crediblex
changeSet.comment: Send CHANGEEXPIRYDATE to active hooks that already receive Line of Credit events, so LOS gets the updated dates.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_hook_registered_events (hook_id, entity_name, action_name) SELECT DISTINCT h.id, 'LINE_OF_CREDIT', 'CHANGEEXPIRYDATE' FROM m_hook h JOIN m_hook_registered_events re ON re.hook_id = h.id WHERE h.is_active = true AND re.entity_name = 'LINE_OF_CREDIT' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_hook_registered_events existing WHERE existing.hook_id = h.id AND existing.entity_name = 'LINE_OF_CREDIT' AND existing.action_name = 'CHANGEEXPIRYDATE' );
